task: Deploy weight-paint PWA to all game repos + guided fix mode
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — owner-directed 2026-10-09: the weight-paint PWA must live in EVERY game repo with GLB models (not a separate tool), and it needs a GUIDED mode because the owner has never done weight painting. CONTEXT: Bannon already has tools/weight-paint-pwa/ (PR #51 merged). The tool works (load/paint/pose/export verified). The owner (Android, no desktop) wants it accessible everywhere and needs hand-holding. YOUR JOB — two parts: PART 1, GUIDED FIX MODE (build in Bannon's copy first): a beginner mode that (a) auto-detects problem verts — raise the arm via the pose slider, compute per-vertex displacement vs rest pose, flag verts that stretch excessively vs their neighbors; (b) highlights them pulsing on the model; (c) gives plain-language steps: 'Tap [bone name]. Paint the glowing verts [color]. Now drag the slider — if it still webs, paint more.' No rigging jargon. Test it on STICKUP_repaired.glb's shoulders — the guided mode must identify the webbing verts and walk a beginner through fixing them. PART 2, DEPLOY: copy the finished tool (with guided mode) to AshLanev2 (~/workspace/game-sweep/AshLanev2, 617 GLBs), ConcreteDragon (~/workspace/ConcreteDragon, 70 GLBs), StreetBrawl (~/workspace/StreetBrawl, 70 GLBs) — each into tools/weight-paint-pwa/, default model URL pointed at that repo's model directory. Each repo: feature branch -> commit -> push -> open PR (never direct to main). The web artifact phone link stays as-is (it loads any GLB). RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint every 15 min; test guided mode yourself before shipping (it must actually flag Stick-Up's shoulder verts); keep the painting core untouched — you're adding a mode, not rewriting. Report: PR links for all three repos + guided-mode self-test result.
result: Guided mode built+tested; deployed to AshLanev2 PR#30, ConcreteDragon PR#14 (covers StreetBrawl=redirect), Bannon guided-mode PR#53
